intent: Facety is a coordination protocol for mutual identification through mutual guarantees and public accountability.

legend.R: protocol transition (selection/reference status stays in basis)
legend.?: missing/unimplemented return; never closed by an invented probability

scope: Maintained map of conceptual, source-implemented, diagnostically exercised and unconfirmed mechanisms, not a preregistration or claim of beneficial emergence.

mechanisms.question: Does contribution induce continued responsible participation?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A subject records fresh identity work or confirms a directed guarantee.
path: FacetyModel terminal disposition credits the subject and recording-time eligible guarantors.
XP changes challenge eligibility, Council ranking and declared XP risk.

feedback.missing: No outcome-driven increase in participation or contribution quality; this is an open behavioral pathway.

mechanisms.signs: + contribution→XP conditional on finality and retained source; XP→quality has no implemented sign.
mechanisms.delay: 24-hour maturity by default; cancelled acts never finalize XP.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Fresh work, qualifying guarantees, attention and fees are distinct resources.
mechanisms.basis: Selected terminal XP and non-transferability; behavioral activity rates are exogenous.
mechanisms.intervention: withholdGuarantorXp is a counterfactual ablation, never a protocol option; compare equal-age/resource populations.
mechanisms.alternative: Arithmetic reward scaling and early bootstrap, not improved responsibility.
mechanisms.falsifier: More XP with unchanged/worse evidence review or contribution quality defeats the behavioral return.
mechanisms.diagram: M01 [R] terminal work → XP → eligibility --[? continued responsibility]--x work

mechanisms.question: Does responsibility produce timely preventive correction?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A suspicious act is observed while a guarantor retains cancellation authority.
path: Fallible observation→declared response and work gate.
Authorized veto burns the right, removes attributable XP and can prevent funded admission.

feedback.implemented: Prevention changes later usable rights, active count and admission opportunities.
feedback.missing: Liability-induced vigilance, D34 historical event-time liability/early self-correction and revised guarantee willingness are absent; D34's eligibility, funding and repeat-event contracts remain OPEN.

mechanisms.signs: − suspicious usable rights if timely/correct; − genuine rights on false positives; no general welfare sign.
mechanisms.delay: Before terminal disposition; invitation cancellation is strictly before the freeze endpoint.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Attention, veto authority and timing; a free protocol veto does not mean zero human work.
mechanisms.basis: Selected model transitions plus explicit fallible observation/response assumptions.
mechanisms.intervention: Remove timely response at the same fresh-act prefix; hold knowledge/timing fixed before studying forgiveness.
mechanisms.alternative: Earlier removal alone, perfect attention, or free unmeasured work.
mechanisms.falsifier: Matched late/early evidence produces no usable prevention or false veto harm outweighs it.
mechanisms.status: Native timing diagnostic; vigilance incentive not established.
mechanisms.diagram: M02 [A] suspicion --[R authority, before spend]--> veto → fewer rights --[? vigilance]--x review

mechanisms.question: Who can withdraw relationship-supported influence?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: Either party ends an active directed guarantee.
path: The ending party pays one liquid FACY into fee custody.
The edge ends; guarantor-derived historical XP is replayed; later credit depends on the edge.

feedback.implemented: Revoked XP changes later eligibility/rank; snapshot veto may persist.
feedback.missing: Evidence→exit choice and expected loss→conduct are not endogenous; concealment/dependence remains a competing hypothesis.

mechanisms.signs: − guarantor XP/fee payer liquidity; ± oversight/liability; no automatic discipline.
mechanisms.delay: Immediate paid exit; pending acts and historical authority have distinct clocks.
mechanisms.bottleneck: One liquid FACY plus lost XP, relationships and possible future opportunities.
mechanisms.basis: Selected either-party exit and fee existence; XP revocation implements D9 DIRECTION, with payer/custody an explicit reference. Voluntary behavior is scripted or narrowly triggered.
mechanisms.intervention: Compare either party ending the same relation; preserve observation capacity; relink semantics require separate audit.
mechanisms.alternative: Lost oversight or self-selection, not deterrence.
mechanisms.falsifier: Fee/XP dependence induces continued concealment or relinking restores unintended credit/authority.
mechanisms.status: Exit/XP diagnostic; incentive sign and historical-liability interaction open.
mechanisms.diagram: M03 [R] either-party exit → fee custody + edge loss → guarantor XP↓ --[? conduct/exit]--x support

mechanisms.question: Can open discovery reach qualified authority?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A member or external observer obtains a fallible public-event signal.
path: Costed observation→package with observation/source IDs→explicit route.
A sponsor can refuse/conflict/miss notice; independent supplied review precedes the existing strict XP/stake gate.
A funded one-step reference case→supplied verdict→shared stake/XP/liability enforcement.

feedback.implemented: Native consequences can change the next formal-access decision (see M07/M09).
feedback.missing: No endogenous search, sponsor competition, compensation collection or outcome-driven investigation.

mechanisms.signs: + reachable formal cases only with available/funded/higher-XP sponsor; wrongful cases and congestion can rise too.
mechanisms.delay: Separate discovery/package/route/review/open/verdict times; supplied hearing delay; unresolved stages stay null.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Work budgets, daily reviewer capacity, conflicts, strict XP, liquid stake and unavailable apex referral.
mechanisms.basis: DIRECTION: discovery is open, formal rights qualified. Unpaid, staged one-step relay is an explicit research reference, not an owner-selected merits procedure.
mechanisms.intervention: Matched-budget member, external-unrouted and external-relay arms; no resource addition. Multi-sponsor/compensation effects remain deferred.
mechanisms.alternative: Extra workforce, oracle review, source allegiance or copies counted as corroboration.
mechanisms.falsifier: At equal resources relay adds no access, overloads reviewers, or causes unacceptable genuine harm.
mechanisms.status: Executed diagnostic reference and small exploration; no mechanism confirmation.
mechanisms.diagram: M04 [A work/capacity] observation → package → review --[R XP/stake]--> case → sanctions --[? investigation]--x discovery

mechanisms.question: Does public exposure attract useful investigative response?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A challenge/entry or conspicuous public history becomes an attention target.
path: Optional attentionFeedback adds challengers/entrants to the screening pool.
Fixed inspection opportunities are redirected; fallible findings can cause more challenges.

feedback.implemented: Challenge→attention→later target allocation is a conditional returning path.
feedback.missing: No learned investigative intensity or demonstrated net correction benefit; targets are not only accused subjects.

mechanisms.signs: + attention→target probability; ± correct/wrongful correction; fixed work can crowd out other subjects.
mechanisms.delay: Later screening/inspection opportunities; public does not mean noticed immediately.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Fixed inspection effort and candidate availability; source/decision quality remain assumptions.
mechanisms.basis: Optional behavioral reference, disabled by default.
mechanisms.intervention: Toggle attentionFeedback with equal inspection work and keyed observations; preserve displaced targets and genuine harms.
mechanisms.alternative: Changing effort, a different candidate set or misleading flag counts.
mechanisms.falsifier: Flag counts rise without downstream correction or with worse genuine-target harm.
mechanisms.status: Source-implemented returning path; effect validation incomplete.
mechanisms.diagram: M05 [A] public participation → attention → later inspections → cases → attention (±; scarce effort)

mechanisms.question: Does growth expand verification capacity or overload it?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A funded invitation admits another subject.
path: New subjects gain future scheduled opportunities, not necessarily independent operators.
Active-population digit count can raise the guarantor threshold.
Additional work consumes shared budgets; acquaintance access can change with graph growth.

feedback.missing: Fresh-media production economies, useful services and calibrated co-presence learning are not endogenous.

mechanisms.signs: + opportunities/workload; + threshold at powers of ten restricts admission; net capacity sign conditional.
mechanisms.delay: 24-hour invitation freeze; 28-day activity window; per-day reference scheduler.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Finite operator/cohort effort, independent human count, qualifying guarantors and access.
mechanisms.basis: Selected admission/activity mechanics plus exogenous activity/matching/cost references.
mechanisms.intervention: Size/age/resource/topology-matched genuine and collusive groups; fixed threshold is only an ablation.
mechanisms.alternative: Arithmetic population rewards or more resources, not better verification.
mechanisms.falsifier: Growth exhausts fixed review capacity faster than it increases usable independent evidence.
mechanisms.status: Implemented constraint return; information-quality scaling untested.
mechanisms.diagram: M06 [R] admission → active N --[R digit threshold; A workload]--> later admission (±)

mechanisms.question: Is earned authority contestable rather than immunity?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: XP changes or a case affects authority-bearing accounts.
path: Strict higher-XP access and liquid stake gate ordinary challenge.
Active XP ranking selects up to 101 Council seats, each with one equal vote.
Existing references can use a Council verdict; sanctions then change future XP/eligibility.

feedback.implemented: Sanctions→XP→later access is exercised; source contains vote→sanction→future membership reference.
feedback.missing: Apex referral, reasoned merits, voting independence and strategic obstruction are unestablished.

mechanisms.signs: + XP→rank/access; − losing-case XP→later access; seat counts do not sign actual decisions.
mechanisms.delay: Terminal XP, case finality and active-member expiry; past decisions are not silently reversed.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Qualified/funded challengers, final human judgment and OPEN case-admission/merits rules.
mechanisms.basis: Selected active top-101 equal-vote architecture; smaller Council and depth-triggered merits are named references.
mechanisms.intervention: Withhold one terminal disposition at a rank boundary; matched XP/age and tie-break controls before interpreting capture.
mechanisms.alternative: ID tie-breaking, arithmetic threshold or fixed coalition ballots.
mechanisms.falsifier: A seat shift without a wrongful decision cannot support capture; restored evidence access that removes influence weakens self-protection.
mechanisms.status: Threshold and later-gate diagnostics; governance effectiveness not confirmed.
mechanisms.diagram: M07 [R] XP → access/seats --[A merits; R equal votes]--> consequence → later XP/access (±)

mechanisms.question: Does future value encourage correction or insider protection?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: An actor anticipates continued network income, credibility or social loss.
path: Protocol balances/XP constrain feasible choices.
Offline games value facts and compare a declared finite strategy menu.

feedback.implemented: Current resources affect feasibility; post-run utility has no automatic return into simulation.
feedback.missing: Network credibility, remaining future opportunities, belief updating, sincere loyalty and adaptive participation are unimplemented.

mechanisms.signs: Unknown: accountability or concealment can both protect perceived future value.
mechanisms.delay: Discounted remaining future income, not sunk effort; no endogenous clock yet.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Calibrated opportunities, preferences, exit options and independent utility evidence.
mechanisms.basis: Behavioral hypotheses; xpValue/civicValue are explicit reference valuations, not universal reputation multipliers.
mechanisms.intervention: Declared valuation/discount/loyalty sweeps and individual deviations; no uncalibrated alignment coefficient.
mechanisms.alternative: Fixed loyalty scripts or favorable civic utility manufacture alignment.
mechanisms.falsifier: Concealment remains individually profitable or utility depends on free external support.
mechanisms.diagram: M08 [O] consequences → supplied valuation --[? beliefs/future choices]--x participation

mechanisms.question: Do false allegations, load and exit damage correction?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A mistaken/hostile report consumes work or reaches adjudication.
path: False signals can trigger costly review or native sanctions against genuine subjects.
Rejected challengers can lose stake and XP, changing later formal access.
Fixed budgets/capacity can leave evidence unresolved; general identity reinstatement is absent.

feedback.implemented: Losing allegation→XP loss→later failed gate is exercised; work exhaustion blocks later actions.
feedback.missing: Overload→voluntary exit→capacity loss and restoration of wrongfully invalidated identity are unimplemented.

mechanisms.signs: − resources/XP can limit repeat allegations and honest sponsorship; ± net safety; exit sign unknown.
mechanisms.delay: Daily review cap, hearing delay and unresolved queue age; no automatic restoration deadline.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Review work, funding, fallible merits and irreversible exclusion under current transitions.
mechanisms.basis: Selected/native sanctions with explicit one-step verdict inputs; capacity/declared conflict policy are research assumptions.
mechanisms.intervention: Matched false-allegation input and capacities 1/2; preserve genuine harm, not only corrected violations.
mechanisms.alternative: Removing participants makes fraud shares look better; rejected packages excluded from latency summaries.
mechanisms.falsifier: A seeming safety gain disappears when genuine retention, pending evidence and irreversible loss are included.
mechanisms.status: Exercised encoded balancing constraint plus exploratory burden; exit/repair loop open.
mechanisms.diagram: M09 [A false signal/load] case → [R stake/XP loss] → later access↓; [? exit/repair] open

mechanisms.question: Can correction resume after neglect without resetting history?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: Sponsor availability or ordinary attention returns after an outage.
path: A queued package retains its observations/routes and timestamps.
Restored reviewer availability can resume native case processing with current funds/XP.

feedback.implemented: Availability restoration→processing is exercised as an exogenous intervention.
feedback.missing: No endogenous restoration trigger, reasoned precedent, calibrated learning or general reinstatement.

mechanisms.signs: + availability→service only if remaining gates permit; no guaranteed health/stability sign.
mechanisms.delay: Explicit 24-hour outage plus hearing; harmful state/history is not rolled back.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Accumulated authority, available stakes, work and OPEN due-process repair.
mechanisms.basis: Exogenous bounded diagnostic, not a selected institutional-learning mechanism.
mechanisms.intervention: Compare ordinary vs restored schedule on the same prefix; retain delay and cumulative damage, not just endpoint share.
mechanisms.alternative: A scripted restoration or return to a compromised baseline is mistaken for learning/recovery.
mechanisms.falsifier: Correction remains blocked after restoration, or irreversible wrongful harm survives apparent metric return.
mechanisms.status: Restoration pathway diagnostic; health/learning hypothesis open.
mechanisms.diagram: M10 [A outage/restoration] capacity↓↑ → queued processing --[? institutional learning]--x later conduct

mechanisms.question: Does debt restrict and then restore disposable capacity?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A fine exceeds current liquid funds.
path: Uncollected fine becomes debt, never a burn.
Future accepted-subject emissions are reserved, remain vetoable, then burn at maturity to repay debt.
Reduced debt permits later disposable emissions.

feedback.implemented: Debt→reserved future rights→repayment→less debt→disposable rights is a balancing stock loop.
feedback.missing: No debt-induced behavior adaptation; invalidation can prevent future work/repayment.

mechanisms.signs: − future disposable rights while debt>0; − debt only after actual repayment burn.
mechanisms.delay: Spend maturity; veto/locks can postpone or prevent recovery.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Future valid work and continued accepted identity.
mechanisms.basis: Selected veto-preserving recovery; immediate burn is an explicit comparison.
mechanisms.intervention: Hold work constant and compare debt/no debt or a vetoed reservation; immediate burn is a non-default comparison.
mechanisms.alternative: Nominal debt mislabeled loss or burn.
mechanisms.falsifier: Debt falls without actual recoverable burning or a vetoed right repays debt.
mechanisms.status: Direct transition regressions; no population-stability claim.
mechanisms.diagram: M11 [R] debt → reserve future right --[maturity, veto survives]--> burn → debt↓ (balancing)

mechanisms.question: Do adjudication histories improve decisions or reinforce errors?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A ladder settles and updates public participation/win/loss history.
path: Procedural wins/losses alter opposing-entrant priors.
Participation familiarity changes regular-noticer selection.
Graph structural rank is a separate screening/prior input.

feedback.implemented: Settlement records→later prior/notice→entry→new settlement is source-implemented.
feedback.missing: Procedural success is not truth accuracy; no controlled beneficial effect established.

mechanisms.signs: ± reinforcement: accurate and mistaken outcomes can both reinforce later beliefs.
mechanisms.delay: Later cases; record retention is not calibrated learning.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Independent evidence and opportunity to notice/enter.
mechanisms.basis: Optional research modifiers, zero by default; XP, reputation and familiarity remain distinct.
mechanisms.intervention: Toggle trackRecordWeight/regularsNotice independently; inject early errors at matched evidence/work.
mechanisms.alternative: More notices or cohort composition, not better credibility estimates.
mechanisms.falsifier: Records reinforce early wrong verdicts or weights never change a downstream decision.
mechanisms.diagram: M12 [A] procedural record → prior/familiarity → later entry → record (±)

mechanisms.question: Does gossip inform correction or spread mistaken suspicion?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: A suspicious observation is shared through acquaintance channels.
path: Watch lists bias subsequent inspections.
Participants' neighborhoods can expand timed-dispute notice.

feedback.implemented: Suspicion→watch list→later inspection→suspicion is an optional returning path.
feedback.missing: No retraction/forgetting, calibrated independence or guaranteed beneficial propagation.

mechanisms.signs: + notice/exposure conditional on graph and gossip share; false suspicion can amplify too.
mechanisms.delay: Later inspection/timed rounds and bounded hop count.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Communication access, finite inspection effort and correlated mistakes.
mechanisms.basis: Optional behavioral reference; acquaintance channels are not guarantee or invitation rights.
mechanisms.intervention: Equal-work gossip on/off, independent/shared errors, and displaced-target controls.
mechanisms.alternative: An adjacency bonus, extra work or positive-only examples.
mechanisms.falsifier: Repeated false suspicion persists or apparent gain disappears under matched independent evidence.
mechanisms.diagram: M13 [A] suspicion → acquaintance notice/watchlist → later suspicion (±; no retraction)

mechanisms.question: Can public cash-out expose fraud without punishing ordinary payments?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: Several subjects transfer liquid FACY to one recipient.
path: Distinct-sender hub flags enter screening.
Fallible review can trigger sanctions and constrain later conversion/transfers.

feedback.implemented: Cashout→flags→screening→sanctions→future cashout capacity is a conditional path.
feedback.missing: Adaptive laundering and reliable money-flow attribution are not implemented.

mechanisms.signs: + consolidation→visibility; ± precision with background payments; sanctions constrain capacity.
mechanisms.delay: Historical transfers and next inspection opportunities.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Observable consolidation, threshold, review effort and common legitimate payments.
mechanisms.basis: Optional behavioral detection reference, not automatic sanction for graph density or transfers.
mechanisms.intervention: Same transfers/resources with honest payment noise and non-consolidation controls.
mechanisms.alternative: Attention shares the historical flowFlagged counter; flag count is not exclusively flow detection.
mechanisms.falsifier: Ordinary recipients dominate flags or consolidation can be avoided without any modeled utility loss.
mechanisms.status: Flagging/precision tests; adaptive feedback effect not confirmed.
mechanisms.diagram: M14 [A] transfers → flow flags → review --[R] sanctions → future transfers↓ (conditional)

mechanisms.question: Can correction propagate through a network without guilt by association?
mechanisms.initiatingChange: An upheld case exposes related public subjects or defending entrants.
path: Optional lineage investigation spends bounded follow-up work.
Cluster references can propose cases against defenders; each merits path remains an OPEN reference.

feedback.missing: Losing defense does not prove a violation; informed obstruction and independent review are not supplied by association.

mechanisms.signs: + follow-up cases, including erroneous cascades; net benefit unknown.
mechanisms.delay: After verdict, maxFollowUps and case clocks.
mechanisms.bottleneck: Work, qualification and independent evidence for each additional case.
mechanisms.basis: Optional research stress script; no selected automatic guilt of associates.
mechanisms.intervention: Toggle follow-ups with equal work, genuine/collusive matched neighborhoods and erroneous seed verdicts.
mechanisms.alternative: Encoded association sanctions or a non-executing branch (a >=0 counter is not a positive witness).
mechanisms.falsifier: False initial judgment produces a cascade, or cluster follow-up never actually executes in claimed evidence.
mechanisms.status: Lineage work bounded by tests; cluster positive-execution/effect evidence incomplete.
mechanisms.diagram: M15 [A] verdict → lineage/defender follow-up → cases → verdict (±; no guilt inference)

inventory.scope: All normalized runExperiment default controls are covered by grouped paths (tested). Dynamic schedules reuse action units. Graph/proof benchmarking, CLI execution, registration/statistical-analysis settings and historical study JSON are separately owned by their existing contracts; this is not a complete historical-consumer migration audit.

parameters.meaning: Choose scenario, rounded initial attacker count and topology; genesis acquisition is unpriced. Requested/evolving shares and humans/subjects differ.
Reproduction input; not a human trait. Requires source and randomness identity.
Exposure endpoint, not the last retained row or endogenous lifetime.
Chance of preferring a local-authority act, not observation quality.

parameters.units: probability conditional on evaluator violation/genuine label
parameters.meaning: Fallible first-stage hit/false-suspicion rates, distinct from review/verdict accuracy.
Resource safety censors, not endogenous carrying capacity or economic exhaustion.
Conditional success test; Council share is not demonstrated corrupt governance.
Snapshot retention, never an actor policy.
Respectively fresh-act attempt, authorized suspicious response, eligible challenge, pending-invitation review, ladder defense, eligible cashout and conversion. Fixed rates do not adapt to outcomes.
Demand for each named action; floor(rate)+Bernoulli(fraction), not Poisson. More subjects increase workload, not free operator capacity.
Finite work resources; denial is economic exhaustion, not maxActions censoring.
15 distinct action prices; rejected attempted work is charged, denied work is not. selfId/fakeSelfId are not probabilities or token prices.
Alternative strategy subset; omitted activities inherit default cohort activity, not configured conformist behavior.

parameters.units: records: id, startDay/endDay in days, activity overrides
parameters.meaning: Exogenously alters named cohort actions; no endogenous learning. Activity units match the activity inventory.
Terminal credit default; immediate is comparison, not interchangeable timing.
Historical snapshot/current-edge comparison; do not merge historical authority with present relationships.
Active accepted Council membership is selected; accepted-only is a historical comparison.
Zero default; a positive fee is held, not burned. Unspecified Emitter commitment not invented.
Selected target 101; small named boundary references do not change it. XP ranks seats, not vote weight.
Veto-preserving reservation default; immediate burn remains comparison. Debt is not collection.
24-hour default; cancel strictly before the endpoint, accept at/after it.
Default revoke implements D9 DIRECTION; attributable guarantor credits are replayed. Keep is a comparison, not a selection. Either-party historical semantics remain a research boundary.
Both default 24, but their interventions and flows differ; equal values do not authorize fusion.
OPEN production interpretation: registration-only legacy vs once-per-subject reference; group claims remain distinct.
Remove guarantor credit, replace digit threshold, or remove preferential matching independently. Never protocol options.
Enable one-step, instant ladder or timed ladder; all merits institutions remain OPEN.
Accuracy of supplied adjudication environment, not an actor truth oracle or observation rate.

parameters.units: FACY; fractional ladder increase; custody enum
parameters.meaning: Entry commitment, escalation and exclusive custody vs unsecured promise are separate; backing remains OPEN.
Fixed vs chain fine and subjects exposed; fixed fine inactive in chain mode. Association is not evaluator proof.
Transfer actual liquid collection, not nominal debt or a free subsidy.
Loser XP risk and optional collateral exclusion; liable halving on upheld cases is separately encoded.
Distinct evidence-quality contexts, not a combined trust score.

parameters.units: stake-comparison units per XP; per entry
parameters.meaning: Supplied private risk/civic valuation; neither market price nor application externality evidence.
Experimental finality/search caps, not computational censoring or automatically last-unopposed timeout.
OPEN depth-triggered reference, not selected apex admission.

parameters.scope: opening structural prior; opposing-entrant record prior respectively
parameters.meaning: Different public signals: graph rank versus procedural record. Not XP, familiarity or truth accuracy.
Timeout after last entry; independent throughput. Clock and service capacity are not one parameter.
Base sampled attention and extra familiarity notice; public does not imply universal observation.

parameters.units: accuracy increment per relative XP height
parameters.meaning: Explicit signal-sharpening reference, bounded at consumption; not calibrated emergent evidence quality.
Lowest/highest/random reference scheduler order can affect winners.
Public-proof is fallible common evidence, not cryptographic truth. Shared error is explicit.
Optional stress reference does not prove every defender committed another offense.
Public/acquaintance matching and stranger exception; acquaintance channels are not procedural rights.
Root-seeded graph rank selects candidates; rank is not guilt. Quantile and share have distinct roles.
Optional independent noisy verification before veto/challenge; distinct from first-stage suspicion and verdict.
Bounded investigation work, not mandatory group guilt.
Exogenous acceptance and unfunded external bookkeeping, not FACY market execution or endogenous loyalty.
Narrow paid relation withdrawal, not general population exit or learned defection.
Flow visibility and ordinary one-FACY payment noise; no punitive density rule.
Adds public participants to attention pool; no extra baseline inspection effort.
Bounded public suspicion propagation and preferential inspection, with no retraction model.
Activity-qualified vs accepted guarantor reference; do not infer owner selection from an active default.

viewParameters.meaning: Fixed work endowment, one unit per observation/package/route/processed review/formal attempt; zero-cost blocked unavailable/capacity checks do not claim completed work.
Maximum processed reviews in each half-open 24-hour day; separate from total work and availability.
0 disables retention; saturation counts omitted records and never truncates protocol semantics.
viewParameters.provenance: CausalJournal instrumentation limit, not an agent policy

viewParameters.meaning: Supplied fallible observation/source declarations, availability/disclosed conflict and separate reference verdict. Source labels are not authenticated independent sources or correctness.
Example-only prevalence, detection/review/verdict probabilities, shared-error mixture, capacity and window; retain exact values in output. They do not modify full-model defaults.
viewParameters.provenance: examples/causal-relay.mjs supplied inputs; no human calibration

state.purpose: Subject-level formal authority; replay is deliberate audit state, not a second trust quantity.
Liquid spending, outstanding rights, retained fees, reserved funds and promised/actual settlement are distinct. Monetary authority stays in FacetyModel.
Actual issue/burn versus unpaid obligations; supply/custody reconcile independently.
Accepted identity and account authority, not evaluator genuine/false labels or proof of unique personhood.
Freshness, distinct media claims/collision, terminal disposition, original guarantors, source credits and locks; hashless media authenticity is abstract.
Present guarantee consent/lifecycle vs historical funded admission. One directed guarantee never silently creates its reverse.
24-hour rate, 28-day accepted activity and veto-preserving recovery. Redundancy requires equivalence proof before removal.
Targeting, familiarity, procedural reliability and structural rank remain separate from XP and actual truth.
Attempt/reject/deny and cohort/action/phase reconciliation; staged preparation can consume work even when admission fails.
Explicit source/review ancestry, access bottlenecks, pending stages; no external protocol account or compensating mint.
Compute false/genuine/ownership harm and denominators; never feed defender choice except through declared noisy observations/verdict environment.

measurements.purpose: Distinct outcome dimensions with denominators/horizon; zero-XP concentration null. Seats do not prove a malicious vote.
Flows, stocks and opportunities differ. eligibleForUnmodeledXpChallenge is a historical name: it counts higher-XP outsider suspicions even with disputes enabled.
Compatibility name for all incoming protocol transfers, not only challenge rewards, not net profit. Liquid wealth plus gross inflow can double-value money if an analyst chooses both.
Historical set size also includes attention subjects, not exclusively flow detection or all final screening candidates.
Exact current disposition category, not exhaustive historical invitation-origin burns after cancellation/voiding; event ledger is authoritative for actual burn.
Raw graph reachability vs invalidated-node-blocked paths respectively; do not merge because simple baseline endpoints happen to agree.

Offline analyst criteria, not automatic actor adaptation or proof of a mechanism. Saved-game budget means require complete valid observations; positive-support expectations carry unknowns; mandatory/enabled viability criteria cannot pass without data. Retention needs a positive baseline. Disabled caps and zero mixture support are not measured zeros. Declared replica cohorts must be complete/aligned; known-subset payoff statistics cannot supply complete-data response/matrix claims, and raw sanction means propagate missingness uniformly. Game summaries also require the analysis input binding to match record/valuation/alpha/source/runtime; neither seed consistency nor the fingerprint authenticates evidence or outputs. See the games contract.
Pinned historical 72/168/0-hour fixture, not duplicate current 24-hour policy; preserve historical dependency until a new study is run.

simplifications.change: Removed dispute.taken; subject is excluded explicitly and participant membership is derived from the owned stake-book positions through hasParticipant.
simplifications.why: One authority for entrant membership, not a synchronized duplicate set.
simplifications.evidence: Twelve predeclared procedure/backing/social contexts compare all retained fields and full ordered protocol events except provenance; focused dispute tests.

simplifications.change: One shared challengeAccess and one-step stake/enforceIdentityVerdict implementation used by the scheduler and evidence reference.
simplifications.why: The explanatory view cannot drift into a second economic/adjudication implementation.
simplifications.evidence: Same twelve-context preservation and native accounting/XP regressions; no default configuration change.

simplifications.change: Named input-driven observations/reviews/verdicts, fixed one-unit relay work and one-step procedure; use native funded prefixes and real state transitions.
simplifications.why: Expose individual stage failures without introducing a generic agent framework or universal trust score.
simplifications.evidence: Walkthroughs and paired exploration are diagnostic/exploratory only; no endogenous search/compensation/adoption/learning. Signal quality, capacity, correlation and wrongful harm remain visible.

simplifications.change: Reject public null actors; preflight whole-verdict aggregate-debt arithmetic before reference custody settlement; journal unexpected failures and rethrow.
simplifications.why: Independent review reproduced free unregistered work and a numeric overflow that partially settled/stranded a case.
simplifications.evidence: Targeted negative and exact-headroom regressions. Ordinary twelve-context results remain equivalent; numeric failure semantics deliberately improve. Exclusive book ownership and normalized coherent model state remain limits.

simplifications.change: Removed unreachable src/relay.mjs, src/trace.mjs and src/walkthroughs.mjs (638 source lines) and their unused inventory controls.
simplifications.why: Their only code consumers were inside the same discarded component; no CLI, example, test or retained study imported it. The private package declares no library exports.
simplifications.evidence: At de0365b, studies/2026-10-23-dead-code/preservation.mjs compared the previous committed implementation and all 10 walkthroughs/288 paired runs, excluding only provenance; all 116 then-existing study files stayed byte-identical. Its deletion-only guard intentionally refuses subsequent source edits. A changed fingerprint is not historical confirmation.

simplifications.change: Removed game safety zero-imputation across retained-replica means, supported equilibrium observations and active viability criteria; reject invalid analyst limits and leave non-positive-baseline retention undefined.
simplifications.why: Saved-data witnesses passed explicit fraud budgets or mandatory retention/sanction criteria without measured support. Unknown is not zero, an excluded profile or a disabled criterion.
